text: When the boat bumped against the posts. <break time="0.8s" /> The boatmen called out Arsats name. <break time="0.8s" /> But no answer came from the house. <break time="0.8s" /> And the silence seemed to grow deeper. <break time="0.8s" /> The chief boatman announced sulkily. <break time="0.8s" /> That they would cook and sleep in the boat. <break time="0.8s" /> On the open water. <break time="0.8s" /> And the white man. <break time="0.8s" /> Asking only for his blankets. <break time="0.8s" /> Climbed up alone. <break time="0.8s" /> Then Arsat came out of the low doorway. <break time="0.8s" /> A young, broad chested man. <break time="0.8s" /> Wearing only a sarong. <break time="0.8s" /> And without any of the usual greetings. <break time="0.8s" /> He asked, Have you medicine, Tuan. <break time="0.8s" /> No, said the white man, startled. <break time="0.8s" /> But why do you ask. <break time="0.8s" /> Is there sickness in the house. <break time="0.8s" /> And Arsat answered only, Enter and see. <break time="0.8s" /> Turning back into the dim house. <break time="0.8s" /> Inside, on a raised couch of bamboo. <break time="0.8s" /> Lay a woman covered with a red cloth. <break time="0.8s" /> Her eyes wide open but seeing nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> As if she were staring. <break time="0.8s" /> At something far away. <break time="0.8s" /> Her cheeks burned with a high fever. <break time="0.8s" /> And the white man. <break time="0.8s" /> Seeing the stillness of her face. <break time="0.8s" /> Understood at once. <break time="0.8s" /> That she was very close to death. <break time="0.8s" /> She hears nothing now, Tuan, Arsat said. <break time="0.8s" /> And I have not slept for five nights. <break time="0.8s" /> For at first she struggled. <break time="0.8s" /> Hearing voices calling her. <break time="0.8s" /> From the water. <break time="0.8s" /> Arsat asked in a low voice. <break time="0.8s" /> Tuan, will she die. <break time="0.8s" /> And the white man. <break time="0.8s" /> Looking at the still face on the couch. <break time="0.8s" /> Could only answer sadly. <break time="0.8s" /> That he feared so.
